record.question: Who is the author of 'The Lushai Verb, Lushai Double Adverbs'?
record.explanation: F. J. Sandy authored Notes on Lushai Grammar: The Lushai Verb (1918). The British Library’s original-item catalog names him; Lorrain also identifies Sandy’s treatment of Lushai double adverbs. Reference: https://searcharchives.bl.uk/catalog/040-002725255; https://dsal.uchicago.edu/dictionaries/lorrain/frontmatter/introduction.html. Original printed source and ordered choices independently reviewed. Verified worked solution, unofficial; no matching examiner key is asserted.
